LanguageData.DMS_MachineCabinet.label: machine cabinet
LanguageData.DMS_MachineCabinet.description: A machine cabinet containing many sophisticated instruments that improve the product quality of automated workstations, such as laser positioners for calibration and temperature sensors. These instruments also improve work efficiency.\n\nEach production building can link up to 8 machine cabinets, and when producing items that have quality, each linked cabinet has a 25% chance to raise the quality by one level.
